# Parkland Consulting Group

> Parkland Consulting Group is a pattern-led growth strategy firm based in Atlanta, Georgia, serving small and growing businesses across the United States in any industry. Founded by Charnell Smith-Landry. Slogan: "Grow on Patterns, Not Hunches." Parkland helps business owners read their data, signals and patterns, then decide what to focus on next: where to grow, how to scale and how to communicate. Clients have included retail and ecommerce, beauty and wellness, food and beverage, early education and service businesses.

## About the founder

Charnell Smith-Landry founded Parkland Consulting Group. She is a strategist with a 25-year career in digital, marketing and technology, including more than 15 years of independent consulting and in-house digital leadership at a fast-growing national company. She has worked with Cox Communications, Inspire Brands, Tropical Smoothie Cafe, SunTrust (now Truist) and founder-led small businesses. She holds a master's degree in project management and a bachelor's degree in computer information systems, and has been a keynote and panel speaker at industry conferences.

## How Parkland works

Each engagement has a lead strategist and a bench of designers, full-stack developers, dashboard builders, channel auditors and trusted partners, so clients get one clear plan and a full team to carry it out.

## Services

- [Pattern Audit](https://parkland.consulting/services/pattern-audit/): The entry point. A fixed-fee, three-to-four-week review of customers, operations, performance and technology that delivers a readout, a ranked 90-day action plan and a 30-day check-in. Investment starting from $3,000, or two payments of $1,500. 15% off project work booked within two weeks of the readout.
- [Growth Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/growth-strategy/): Where to grow next, which customers and channels to prioritize and what to stop doing.
- [Scale Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/scale-strategy/): The systems, tools, customer-facing experience and team readiness to grow without breaking what works.
- [Communication Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/communication-strategy/): How a brand speaks to customers, teams and partners across channels.
- [All services and engagement options](https://parkland.consulting/services/): Project work from $7,500, advisory from $3,500 per month, fractional leadership from $6,500 per month.
